title: Prayer for Restoration

questions.question: Remember, O LORD, what has befallen us; look, and see our what?
Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to whom?
We have become orphans, fatherless; our mothers are like what?
Slaves rule over us; there is none to deliver us from their what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:8 (ESV): "there is none to deliver us from their hand."

questions.question: But you, O LORD, reign for how long?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:19 (ESV): "But you, O LORD, reign forever;"

questions.question: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the what in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:9 (ESV): "We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness."

questions.question: Our skin is hot as an oven with the burning heat of what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:10 (ESV): "Our skin is hot as an oven with the burning heat of famine."

questions.question: Princes are hung up by their hands; no respect is shown to whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:12 (ESV): "no respect is shown to the elders."

questions.question: The joy of our heart has ceased; our dancing has been turned to what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:15 (ESV): "our dancing has been turned to mourning."

questions.question: Restore us to yourself, O LORD, that we may be restored! Renew our days as of when?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:21 (ESV): "Renew our days as of old--"

questions.question: What have they done to the women in Zion and the virgins in the towns of Judah?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:11 (ESV): "Women are raped in Zion, virgins in the towns of Judah."

questions.question: Young men are compelled to grind at the mill, and youths stagger under loads of what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:13 (ESV): "and youths stagger under loads of wood."

questions.question: What has fallen from their head?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:16 (ESV): "The crown has fallen from our head;"

questions.question: Why has our heart become sick and our eyes grown dim?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:17 (ESV): "For this our heart has become sick, for these things our eyes have grown dim,"

questions.question: The text implies a conditional statement at the end: "unless you have utterly rejected us, and are angry with us..."?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 5:22 (ESV): "unless you have utterly rejected us, and are angry with us beyond measure."

key_verse_text: But you, O LORD, reign forever; your throne endures to all generations.
